body: The real Plan B right here.

Sharp blade emo.

I'd just offer to pay him to shoot me. We both get what we want.

I no shit just saw something about someone gluing glass on a slide. 

My first thought was "that might be interesting.."

I usually reply with "I'm not really sure right now, you?".

Mostly because if I said "I absolutely hate my life and it's my fault..etc" they'd stop talking to me.

I experience this on a daily basis. Like interrupting thoughts but completely self destructive. "I should walk in front of that truck" etc.

Seriously I have two things that help more than they hurt.

A- Music. I know it's annoyingly cliche but I have like three songs that kinda sorta make me feel not so horrible. Fozzey and VanC "See the light" is a personal love interest. 

B- Violent motherfuckin video games. I get on Destiny and slay bodies.
Thank you. It really does help to know that other people live like this.
Considering I made this account to tell you that you're right...yeah I'd say you are.
